headline: Sensex and Nifty Rebound as Bank Nifty Hits Record High; BL Kashyap Surges 15 Percent

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Bank Nifty reaching a new record high during the trading session
Nifty FMCG index snapping a two-day losing streak to support the market rally
Strong recovery following the previous day's losses where the Sensex had tumbled 500 points
Positive sentiment following PM Modi's engagement with India Inc regarding industrial reforms
whatHappening: Sensex gains up to 750 points to reclaim the 25,400 level during intraday trading
BL Kashyap shares experience a significant 15% jump following strong buying interest
The IEA projects a 20% decline in India's crude oil production over the next decade
PM Modi urges India Inc to focus on job creation and higher wages to spur spending
summary: The Indian market saw a strong recovery with the Sensex gaining over 750 points and Bank Nifty reaching a new record high. BL Kashyap shares surged 15%, while the FMCG sector recovered from a two-day slump despite earlier selling pressure in IT and metals. PM Modi emphasized the need for India Inc to improve product quality and increase wages to boost household spending.
